name: Cássia (Brazil)
description: Divided vertically orange and brown in counterchanged halves, with a brown disc at the centre bearing a white shield with a hexagonal device.
history: Cássia is a municipality in the state of Minas Gerais, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 30 November 1970 (the municipal symbols, created by a design agency from Belo Horizonte, were commissioned by Municipal Law No. 427 of 30 November 1970, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: white shield with a hexagonal device
